source_title: First Choice Dental and Milwaukee Dental Partners Join Forces to Expand Wisconsin Network - PR Newswire
source_excerpt:
Partnership adds three family dental practices in West Bend, Jackson and Saukville, extending First Choice Dental's presence in southeastern Wisconsin
MADISON, Wis. , Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- First Choice Dental, a multi-specialty dental group serving Wisconsin families since 1996, today announced a partnership with Milwaukee Dental Partners ("MDP"), a three-practice dental group serving Washington and Ozaukee counties. Effective October 26, 2026, Oakbrook Dental in West Bend, Jackson Family Dentistry in Jackson and Sauk Trail Dental in Saukville join the First Choice Dental network, bringing the group to 20 locations across southern and southeastern Wisconsin.
Patients will continue to receive high-quality care from the same doctors, hygienists and team members at their existing offices. The practices will retain their current names and continue accepting the same insurance plans. Through the partnership, patients will also have access to First Choice Dental's broader network of dentists and specialists, with services that include orthodontics, periodontics, endodontics and oral surgery.
"Dr. Major and his team share our belief that great dental care starts with trust and long-term relationships," said Kelly Thompson, President and Chief Operating Officer of First Choice Dental. "They have built practices that are an important part of their communities, and we are proud to welcome them to the First Choice Dental family. We look forward to supporting their teams and serving more communities across Wisconsin."
"Taking care of our patients starts with taking care of our people," Thompson added. "Our doctors make the clinical decisions, and we provide the training, resources and operational support that allow them to focus on their patients. That commitment has been our mission for 30 years and will guide our partnership with the teams in West Bend, Jackson and Saukville."
"I founded Milwaukee Dental Partners to do more good for more people and to create a place where our doctors and team members could grow," said Dr. Pako Major, founder of Milwaukee Dental Partners. "First Choice Dental shares those priorities. This partnership gives our patients access to a broader range of care and gives our team more opportunities for mentorship, continuing education and career growth. Just as important, it allows us to preserve the relationships and personal attention our patients value."
The partnership continues First Choice Dental's expansion beyond Dane County and marks its first locations in communities north of Milwaukee. The group opened its Janesville office in June, bringing its care to patients in Rock County as well. A new office in Pewaukee is also scheduled to open in December 2026 as the group continues to grow throughout Wisconsin.
Founded in 1996 by three Madison-area dentists, First Choice Dental is a multi-specialty dental group serving families across southern and southeastern Wisconsin. Its dentists and in-house specialists provide comprehensive care, including general and preventive dentistry, restorative and cosmetic dentistry, dental implants, orthodontics, periodontics, endodontics, oral surgery, sedation dentistry, emergency care and dentistry for children. First Choice Dental is committed to making dental care comfortable and convenient while building lasting relationships with patients and supporting the professional growth of its team members.
Milwaukee Dental Partners is a group of three family dental practices serving communities north of Milwaukee: Oakbrook Dental in West Bend, Jackson Family Dentistry in Jackson and Sauk Trail Dental in Saukville. Founded in 2019 by Dr. Pako Major, MDP provides comprehensive general and family dentistry to more than 6,600 active patients. The group's mission is to do more good for more people through quality patient care, continuing education and investment in its teams and communities.
